recipe.method: Split, bin to 30 s and 128 channels, export to FITS, MIRIAD invert with natural weighting, clean, restore; sets A, B and combined

recipe.goal: Fit disk and point source in visibilities
recipe.method: MCMC fit of two-boundary power-law disk or Gaussian ring plus point source to both data sets simultaneously, with model-minus-data residual imaging
key_parameters: 8/9 free parameters; disk centered on star
assumptions: Optically and geometrically thin disk; Td = 278.3 L*^0.25 r^-0.5; L* = 6 Lsun; d = 83.8 pc

recipe.method: MCMC fit to combined dirty map with ring center free; correlated-noise factor sqrt(beam pixels)

recipe.goal: Characterize point sources and minimize contamination
recipe.method: Long-baseline (>80 kλ) map, uvmodelfit of two point sources, subtraction to make disk-only map, refit with fixed sources, masking >0.1 mJy/beam, or Gaussian source

recipe.goal: Radial and azimuthal profiles and SED, bright source nature, planet constraints
recipe.method: Elliptical annuli of 0.4" and 27° wedges; revised SED model; background galaxy probabilities from Schechter function; chaotic zone width formulas
assumptions: Dust opacity 2.3 cm2/g at 1.3 mm, Td 30–60 K for CPD; M*=1.6 Msun

answer_key.quantity: Total disk flux density at 1.3 mm
